global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with sliced green onions and a pink naruto fish cake, it sits in a white bowl with red rim, under warm, inviting light on a wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns and subtle texture under even lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, red brushstroke pattern and small red logo on rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is amber-brown, frothy, and rich, swirling around noodles and garnishes with visible bubbles and oil sheen.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a glossy, irregularly shaped piece with a pinkish-brown hue and a visible orange-red sauce spot on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots: pale yellow, slightly translucent, elongated with visible fibrous texture and faint green tip.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pinkish-white, smooth surface with subtle gradient, slightly glossy finish.
